answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can influence a vote, and cap its weight by the bond rather than by the number of accounts it creates. A sybil attacker can still wander through the grove of identities, but every added identity needs real capital locked up; detection or rule violations forfeit the bond. The mechanism does not prove one person per account, but it makes fake identities costly to scale and can push an attack below its nadir of profitability.
